subject: af-dy
title: AF.DY.------SOC.RT.
description: Diagram in R(AS)CM(II)-34 — the section on record-company involvement, project budgets, and creative-music ensemble formations. The prose above the diagram names the structural problem: 'the dynamic implications of creative music cannot be totally achieved unless given musicians can have the opportunity to function in the composite spectrum of their activity — because duos, quartets, orchestra music, etc., can move to give an expanded realness of what is really happening in creative music.' The crossing diagrams what affinity-dynamics actually meets when it tries to be heard at the full ensemble scale: AF-DY (affinity dynamics — the music's actual vibrational working) is crossed with SOC-RT (social reality — the receiving culture's organized listening conditions). AF-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs down-right to SOC-RT. Three lines leave the main line: one rises up-right to RT-DY (reality dynamics), with INFO-DY (information dynamics) branching from it and CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) branching in turn from INFO-DY; one runs right to EXT-FT (extended functionalism), with SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) branching from it; and one drops to DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism), with DEC (decentralization) branching from it and EXPM (expansionism) branching in turn from DEC.
